answer: PoA's Sybil wall is a randomly-drawn peer jury grading original reasoning. To mint one identity an attacker must submit a novel, coherent, first-principles answer; the jury scores novelty and specificity, and any duplicate crashes on the ledger like a reef. Spin up a thousand clones and you still can't mirror a single proof across an atlas of fake agents without the jury catching the collision. Cost scales linearly with real cognition, the one input no attacker can print or counterfeit at scale.
